issue.title: memory: port `memory sync` and the sync client
issue.body:
## Context
Any `memory sync <remote>` invocation goes to Go (`cmd/symbrain/cmd_memory_sync.go`, `internal/memory/syncclient`). See `MEMORY-SYNC-MIGRATION.md`.

## Scope
- Port the sync protocol client with transcripts from a local fake sync server; conflict and retry behaviour identical to Go.

## Acceptance
- Sync differential passes on native three-OS CI; `memory_cli::requires_go_fallback` is removed entirely.

**Blocked by:** #758

---
**Part of:** #731
**Agent notes:** work in an isolated worktree off current `main`; read `AGENTS.md` and the migration ledger first. Until Go is removed, parity evidence must come from real Go-oracle fixtures generated in disposable HOME/XDG roots (no operator credentials). Update the ledger/contract-matrix rows touched by this issue in the same PR. Skipped, zero-case or cross-compiled-only runs are not evidence.
